reviewer.independence: Separate task from production implementation. Inspected all 48 actual native selector/formatter observations. Not independent human/blind evaluation. V1 candidate remains globally rejected due validation regressions.

Preview input is last recorded ASR DraftReplaced, not an observed LLM preview event. This paired stage test is distinct from Coordinator live/stop reproduction and does not establish microphone/window/insertion behavior.
